SQL_TEXT: SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, CODE, NAME, MEASURE_CODE, MEASURE_NAME FROM ( SELECT X0.*, CODE AS MEASURE_CODE, NAME AS MEASURE_NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DIVISION_CODE, (SELECT MIN(V.DIVISION_NAME) FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_CODE) AS DIVISION_NAME, CODE, NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT V.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE, M.COLUMN_NAME AS CODE, NVL(M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, M.COLUMN_NAME) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE M CROSS JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION V WHERE M.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND (M.DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR M.DIVISION_ID = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || M.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || V.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND V.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') ) X ORDER BY DIVISION_CODE, CODE) X) X9 WHERE X9.DIVISION_CODE NOT IN (SELECT V9.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V9 WHERE V9.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE') ) X0 ) X3

SELECT X1.*, SALES_SITE_CODE AS CODE, SALES_SITE_NAME AS NAME FROM ( SELECT X0.*, DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE, DEPT_ID AS TEAM_CODE, DEPT_NAME AS TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER_CODE, SALES_SITE AS SALES_SITE_CODE FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT V.DIVISION_ID, V.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || V.DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, X.DEPT_ID, (SELECT CASE @sesLangCd WHEN 'EN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE D9.DEPT_NAME_KO END FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D9 WHERE D9.DEPT_ID = X.DEPT_ID) AS DEPT_NAME, X.END_CUSTOMER, NVL((SELECT MIN(L9.SEGMENT3) FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT1 = X.DIVISION_ID AND L9.SEGMENT2 = X.END_CUSTOMER), X.END_CUSTOMER) AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME, X.SALES_SITE, X.SALES_SITE_NAME, X.SRC_TYPE, X.SORT_ORDER FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, (SELECT MAX(SI9.DEPT_ID) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI9 WHERE SI9.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SI9.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS SALES_SITE, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SALES_SITE_NAME, 'SITE' AS SRC_TYPE, 2 AS SORT_ORDER FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID), 'SITE', 2 FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT L.SEGMENT3, NULL, NULL, L.SEGMENT1, L.SEGMENT2, 'AS', 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) X ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID WHERE V.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE' AND V.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND V.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') ORDER BY V.DIVISION_ID, X.SORT_ORDER, X.DEPT_ID, X.END_CUSTOMER, X.SALES_SITE) WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT L9.SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL' ) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') OR DEPT_ID IN (SELECT L.SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId) UNION SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId)) ) X0 ) X1

SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, TEAM_CODE, TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER_CODE, END_CUSTOMER_NAME, PLANT_SITE_CODE, PLANT_SITE_NAME, CODE, NAME FROM ( SELECT X1.*, PLANT_SITE_CODE AS CODE, PLANT_SITE_NAME AS NAME FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_NAME, TEAM_CODE, TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER_CODE, END_CUSTOMER_NAME, CODE PLANT_SITE_CODE, NAME PLANT_SITE_NAME FROM (WITH AXIS AS ( SELECT M.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID) N FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY DIVISION_ID) M JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT PLANT_SITE_ID) N FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST WHERE PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL AND PLANT_SITE_ID <> '-' GROUP BY DIVISION_ID) F ON M.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID WHERE F.N >= M.N * 0.5), ITM AS ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' AND DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL) SELECT DIVISION_CODE, ( SELECT MIN(V.DIVISION_NAME) FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_CODE) AS DIVISION_NAME, TEAM_CODE, ( SELECT CASE @sesLangCd WHEN 'EN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE D.DEPT_NAME_KO END FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = X.TEAM_CODE) AS TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER_CODE, NVL((SELECT MIN(L.SEGMENT3) FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT1 = X.DIVISION_CODE AND L.SEGMENT2 = X.END_CUSTOMER_CODE), X.END_CUSTOMER_CODE) AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME, CODE, NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT F.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE, I.DEPT_ID AS TEAM_CODE, NVL(S.END_CUSTOMER, F.PROJECT_CODE) AS END_CUSTOMER_CODE, F.PLANT_SITE_ID AS CODE, F.PLANT_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST F JOIN AXIS Z ON F.DIVISION_ID = Z.DIVISION_ID LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON F.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND F.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN ITM I ON F.DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID AND F.SCM_SITE_ID = I.SCM_SITE_ID WHERE F.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.PLANT_SITE_ID <> '-' AND F.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)), A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM AXIS) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') ) X ORDER BY DIVISION_CODE, CODE) X9 WHERE X9.DIVISION_CODE NOT IN ( SELECT V9.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V9 WHERE V9.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE') ) X1 ) X3

SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, BIZ_TYPE_CODE, BIZ_TYPE_NAME, CODE, NAME FROM ( SELECT X1.*, BIZ_TYPE_CODE AS CODE, BIZ_TYPE_NAME AS NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT DIVISION_CODE, (SELECT MIN(V.DIVISION_NAME) FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_CODE) AS DIVISION_NAME, CODE AS BIZ_TYPE_CODE, NAME AS BIZ_TYPE_NAME FROM ( SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_CODE, L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE, L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_BIZ_TYPE' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND '40' IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT P.DIVISION_ID, P.BIZ_TYPE, P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT P WHERE TRIM(P.BIZ_TYPE_NAME) IS NOT NULL AND P.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y') ) X ORDER BY DIVISION_CODE, CODE) X9 WHERE X9.DIVISION_CODE NOT IN (SELECT V9.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V9 WHERE V9.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE') ) X1 ) X3

SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, CODE, NAME, PLANT_SITE_CODE, PLANT_SITE_NAME FROM ( SELECT X0.*, CODE AS PLANT_SITE_CODE, NAME AS PLANT_SITE_NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT DIVISION_CODE, (SELECT MIN(V.DIVISION_NAME) FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_CODE) AS DIVISION_NAME, CODE, NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')) X ORDER BY DIVISION_CODE, CODE) X9 WHERE X9.DIVISION_CODE NOT IN (SELECT V9.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V9 WHERE V9.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE') ) X0 ) X3

SELECT X1.*, MEASURE_CODE AS CODE, MEASURE_NAME AS NAME FROM ( SELECT X0.*, DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_CODE, SALES_SITE AS SALES_SITE_CODE, MEASURE AS MEASURE_CODE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, DIVISION_NAME, SALES_SITE, SALES_SITE_NAME, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, PROGRAM_ID, SHEET_NAME, LARGE_CLASS, SMALL_CLASS, SORT_ORDER_NO FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT V.DIVISION_ID, V.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || V.DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, X.DEPT_ID, (SELECT CASE @sesLangCd WHEN 'EN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN D9.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE D9.DEPT_NAME_KO END FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D9 WHERE D9.DEPT_ID = X.DEPT_ID) AS DEPT_NAME, X.END_CUSTOMER, NVL((SELECT MIN(L9.SEGMENT3) FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT1 = X.DIVISION_ID AND L9.SEGMENT2 = X.END_CUSTOMER), X.END_CUSTOMER) AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME, X.SALES_SITE, X.SALES_SITE_NAME, M.COLUMN_NAME AS MEASURE, NVL(M.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME, M.COLUMN_NAME) AS MEASURE_NAME, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.SHEET_NAME, M.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME AS LARGE_CLASS, M.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME AS SMALL_CLASS, M.SORT_ORDER_NO FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, (SELECT MAX(SI9.DEPT_ID) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI9 WHERE SI9.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SI9.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS SALES_SITE, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SALES_SITE_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT L.SEGMENT3, NULL, NULL, L.SEGMENT1, L.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) X ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID JOIN SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE M ON M.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND (M.DIVISION_ID IS NULL OR M.DIVISION_ID = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || M.DIVISION_ID || ',', ',' || V.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) WHERE V.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE' AND V.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND V.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')) WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT L9.SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL' ) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') OR DEPT_ID IN (SELECT L.SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId) UNION SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId)) ) WHERE SALES_SITE IS NOT NULL ) X0 ) X1

SELECT X1.*, SALES_SITE_CODE AS CODE, SALES_SITE_NAME AS NAME FROM ( SELECT X0.*, DEPT_ID AS TEAM_CODE, DEPT_NAME AS TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER_CODE, SALES_SITE AS SALES_SITE_CODE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, END_CUSTOMER, END_CUSTOMER_NAME, SALES_SITE, SALES_SITE_NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT V.DIVISION_ID, V.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || V.DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, X.END_CUSTOMER, NVL((SELECT MIN(L9.SEGMENT3) FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT1 = X.DIVISION_ID AND L9.SEGMENT2 = X.END_CUSTOMER), X.END_CUSTOMER) AS END_CUSTOMER_NAME, X.SALES_SITE, X.SALES_SITE_NAME, X.SRC_TYPE, X.SORT_ORDER FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION V JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, (SELECT MAX(SI9.DEPT_ID) FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI9 WHERE SI9.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SI9.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS DEPT_ID, A.END_CUSTOMER, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS SALES_SITE, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID) AS SALES_SITE_NAME, 'SITE' AS SRC_TYPE, 2 AS SORT_ORDER FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID, B.PROJECT_CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(A.SITE_DESCRIPTION), '-'), A.SCM_SITE_ID), 'SITE', 2 FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT L.SEGMENT3, NULL, NULL, L.SEGMENT1, L.SEGMENT2, 'AS', 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) X ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID WHERE V.ATTRIBUTE3 <> 'EE' AND V.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND V.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')) WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT L9.SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L9 WHERE L9.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'GET_ADMIN_GROUP' AND L9.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L9.SEGMENT2 = 'ALL' ) AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') OR DEPT_ID IN (SELECT L.SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PM_TEAM_MAPPING' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT1 IN (SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId) UNION SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U WHERE U.USER_ID = @sesUserId)) ) WHERE DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, SALES_SITE ) X0 ) X1

SELECT DIVISION_CODE, DIVISION_CODE || ' ' || DIVISION_NAME AS DIVISION_NAME, TEAM_CODE, TEAM_NAME, END_CUSTOMER_CODE, END_CUSTOMER_NAME, CODE, NAME, MEASURE, MEASURE_NAME, PROGRAM_ID, SHEET_NAME, LARGE_CLASS, SMALL_CLASS, SORT_ORDER_NO, PLANT_SITE_CODE, PLANT_SITE_NAME, MEASURE_CODE FROM ( SELECT X0.*, CODE AS PLANT_SITE_CODE, NAME AS PLANT_SITE_NAME, MEASURE AS MEASURE_CODE FROM ( SELECT P.*, SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV → E20260819-FCSTTYPE6] 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S)
     → SALES_TYPE_CODE2 ∪ SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD 6종 (2026-08-19 통합테스트 —
     AS-IS DMF0003 FcstTypeEditMode 동형. 구 4종엔 CODE2_ADD(Recall/RMA) 누락) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
       , CASE LOOKUP_TYPE WHEN 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2' THEN DISPLAY_SEQ ELSE 100 + DISPLAY_SEQ END AS DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('SALES_TYPE_CODE2', 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD')
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
  UNION ALL
  /* division 전달 + W/S 자격 아님 → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 전용플래그(ATTRIBUTE2='Y' — 실측 WS/WSF 2건 유일) 제외 = 12종 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    NOT ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                           WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') )
  UNION ALL
  /* division 미전달(메타 셀 콤보 = CODE->NAME 표시 매핑) → 전 코드 1행씩 (중복 없음) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-'
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, CODE

SELECT DISTINCT

	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP --[C20200608-000328] SalesCompany 콤보는 Item Master의 Company ID, Operation Group 기준으로 조회
			FROM   SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM SI
			INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
			ON     SI.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
			WHERE  1=1 --[C20200818-000264] Project_Item Master Valid 조건 제외, Item Master Valid 조건 추가
			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    (I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' OR I.DIVISION_ID = '82')
			AND    I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL --[C20200626-000172]
			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR SI.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@projectCode IS NULL OR @projectCode='' OR SI.PROJECT_CODE=@projectCode)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR SI.ITEM_ID=@itemId)

			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR I.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR I.ITEM_ID=@itemId)

SELECT DISTINCT CODE, NAME FROM (
  /* (1) END_CUSTOMER lookup axis - div 40 표기 원천 [E20260814-ENDCUST] */
  SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, NVL(L.SEGMENT3, L.SEGMENT2) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
  WHERE  L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
  AND    ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-' OR L.SEGMENT1 = TRIM(@divisionId) )
  UNION ALL
  /* (2) div 40 : SITE_ITEM owner axis (AS-IS EndCustomerByDivision40) */
  SELECT A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
  JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND TRIM(@divisionId) = '40' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
  UNION ALL
  /* (3) div 81/82 : 조회조건과 동일 축 = SCM_MST_SITE.END_CUSTOMER (AS-IS BigFilter
         EndCustomerByDivision 의 비40 분기 원문과 동일) [E20260818-ENDCUST81] */
  SELECT S.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, S.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE S
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON D.SEGMENT1 = S.DIVISION_ID AND D.SEGMENT2 = S.END_CUSTOMER
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  S.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL AND NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    S.DIVISION_ID = TRIM(@divisionId) AND TRIM(@divisionId) <> '40'
) ORDER BY UPPER(NAME)

SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV → E20260819-FCSTTYPE6] 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S)
     → SALES_TYPE_CODE2 ∪ SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD 6종 (2026-08-19 통합테스트 —
     AS-IS DMF0003 FcstTypeEditMode 동형. 구 4종엔 CODE2_ADD(Recall/RMA) 누락) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
       , CASE LOOKUP_TYPE WHEN 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2' THEN DISPLAY_SEQ ELSE 100 + DISPLAY_SEQ END AS DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('SALES_TYPE_CODE2', 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD')
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
  UNION ALL
  /* 그 외(40 포함) → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 전용플래그(ATTRIBUTE2='Y' — 실측 WS/WSF 2건 유일) 제외 = 12종(ETC 포함) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'

  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'

         , A.SCM_SITE_ID

    FROM SCM_MST_SITE A

--[E20260812-MKTFCSTEDITMEASURE-V2] AS-IS UP_FX 'MktFcstEditMeasure' 전분기 원문보존 변환 (82+@measure 지정분기 / 일반=INSERT_YN+VMI(@scmSiteId) / CUST_FCST / TMM(@projectCode+@sesUserId) — 상호배타 가드)
SELECT CODE, NAME FROM (
-- ══ 82 지정메저 분기 (원문 IF @PARAM1='82' AND ISNULL(@PARAM5,'')<>'') ══
SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT3 AS NAME, 0 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND SEGMENT2 = @measure
  AND NVL(@divisionId,'-') = '82' 
  --AND @measure IS NOT NULL    --*[20260814] 없어도 될 내용이라 제거
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM 제외 일반 MEASURE (원문 1:1 — VMI_YN = SCM_MST_SITE(@divisionId,@scmSiteId)) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, L.SEGMENT3 AS NAME, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
WHERE 1=1
  AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND NVL(TRIM(L.ATTRIBUTE2),'-') <> 'Y'  -- TMM Measure여부
  AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y'     -- INSERT_YN 여부
  --[C20201015-000200]
  AND ( ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'N' AND L.ATTRIBUTE1 <> 'Y' )
     OR ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'Y' ) )
  AND ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: CUST_FCST MEASURE (원문 1:1) ══
SELECT T.CODE, T.NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.CODE) + 900 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CF.MEASURE AS CODE, ' └ ' || CF.MEASURE AS NAME
	  FROM DM_MST_CUSTOMER_FCST CF
	  WHERE CF.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND CF.MEASURE_GROUP = 'CUST_FCST'
		AND CF.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
		AND CF.SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId) T
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM Measure (원문 1:1 — TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN 게이트 TOP1=ROWNUM) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2, L.SEGMENT3, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
INNER JOIN (SELECT VALID_YN, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT4
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
			WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN'
			  AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
			  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
			  AND SEGMENT2 = @projectCode
			  AND SEGMENT4 = @sesUserId
			  AND ROWNUM = 1) T
  ON ( L.SEGMENT1 = T.SEGMENT1
   AND L.VALID_YN = T.VALID_YN
   AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
   AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
   AND NVL(TRIM(L.ATTRIBUTE2),'-') = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' )
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

  AND ( @divisionId IS NULL
    OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
    OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
  AND ( @deptId IS NULL
    OR @deptId = 'ALL'
    OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || B.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0 )
  AND ( @projectCode IS NULL
    OR @projectCode = 'ALL'

SELECT L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME

  FROM (
			SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, DISPLAY_SEQ, 'Y' AS DM_PLAN_WS_YN

			AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
			UNION ALL
			SELECT SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, DISPLAY_SEQ, 'N' AS DM_PLAN_WS_YN
			FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
			WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
			AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
			AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, '~') <> 'Y'
       ) L
  JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN U.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DM_PLAN_WS_YN
          FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
          JOIN (SELECT USER_GR_ID
                  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MNU_MPG_M
                  WHERE MNU_ID = @mnuId
               ) M
            ON M.USER_GR_ID = U.USER_GR_ID
         WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
           AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
         GROUP BY
               CASE WHEN U.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
       ) G
    ON L.DM_PLAN_WS_YN = G.DM_PLAN_WS_YN

  SELECT SEGMENT1

  WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
    AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    AND SEGMENT1 = '40'
  UNION ALL /* 판매 사이트 원장 - 아이템 원장의 부서마다 한 행 */
  SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
       , B.DEPT_ID

    AND A.END_CUSTOMER = D.SEGMENT2(+)

      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'

      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId

      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
    AND A.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL
    AND A.END_CUSTOMER <> '-'

  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID
       , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS DEPT_ID
       , SEGMENT2 AS CODE
       , NVL(SEGMENT3, SEGMENT2) AS NAME
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE SEGMENT1 IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
      SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' )
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId )
    AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER'
    AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE ,A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN (SELECT SEGMENT2 OPERATION_GROUP ,SEGMENT3 SCM_SITE_ID ,SEGMENT4 LINE_ID ,SEGMENT5 OPERATION_ID ,ATTRIBUTE1 ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PRODUCTION_PLAN' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SSP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ATTRIBUTE2 = @attribute2 ) C ON C.OPERATION_GROUP = @operationGroup AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || C.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0 ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = C.LINE_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS CODE ,'-' AS NAME ORDER BY NAME

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 UNION SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCM_SITE_ID LIKE '%' || '-A' ORDER BY SITE_TYPE

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION || (CASE WHEN B.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL OR C.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ' Y' ELSE ' N' END) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.SCM_SITE_ID=T.PLANT_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID=S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID=T.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID=S.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID=S.PLANT_ID AND LS.OPERATION_ID=T.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID=T.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND T.ITEM_ID = @itemId AND T.VALID_YN='Y' GROUP BY T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID ) B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.PLANT_SITE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND ITEM_ID = @itemId AND VALID_YN ='Y' GROUP BY PLANT_SITE_ID ) C ON A.SCM_SITE_ID= C.PLANT_SITE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID, CODE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.TO_SITE AS CODE , CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.TO_SITE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME FROM ( SELECT TO_SITE FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND OPERATION_GROUP = @param3 GROUP BY TO_SITE ) A , SCM_MST_SITE B WHERE A.TO_SITE = B.SCM_SITE_ID (+) AND @param1 = 'S' UNION ALL SELECT A.TO_SITE AS CODE , A.TO_SITE AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG A WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND A.BIZ_TYPE = @param3 AND @param1 = 'F' GROUP BY A.TO_SITE ) ORDER BY CODE

SELECT DISTINCT P.DIVISION_ID ,P.ITEM_ID ,P.PLANT_SITE_ID ,S.SITE_DESCRIPTION ,LS.LINE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY P JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON P.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND S.OPERATION_GROUP=@operationGroup AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID AND LS.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY P.ITEM_ID, P.PLANT_SITE_ID, LS.LINE_ID

SELECT DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID, NVL(MAX(LOT_SIZE), 0) AS Container_Qty FROM scp_mst_shipment_lot_size WHERE 1 = 1 AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND TRANSPORT_MODE = CASE WHEN FROM_SITE IN ('G382-A','G382-P') THEN 'TRK' ELSE 'SEA' END GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, FROM_SITE, ITEM_ID

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.OSP_YN , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS KPI_ID , A.SEGMENT2 AS KPI_NM , A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID , A.SEGMENT4 AS DEPT_ID , A.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE='SCM_KPI_GOAL' AND A.VALID_YN='Y' ORDER BY A.SEGMENT1, A.SEGMENT3, A.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.OSP_YN , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'N') = @param3 )

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME , A.OPERATION_ID , B.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WHERE b.lookup_type = || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || B.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0) UNION SELECT '-' AS CODE , '-' AS NAME , '-' AS OPERATION_ID , '-' AS SCM_SITE_ID UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME , A.OPERATION_ID , B.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID WHERE b.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || B.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || B.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0) UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME , A.OPERATION_ID , B.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || B.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0) AND A.PLANT_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_SCP', 'PLANT') and A.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000' ORDER BY NAME

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , 'S' AS OSP_YN , '' AS OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

SELECT REPLACE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, '-', '') CODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NAME, TRUNC(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'IW') FROM_DATE, (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + (55)) TO_DATE, PLAN_CUTOFF_CREATE_YN AS PLAN_YN, COMPANY_ID FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE_EE WHERE 1= 1 AND CURRENT_PLAN_DATE_YN = 'Y' AND (@companyId IS NULL OR COMPANY_ID=@companyId) GROUP BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_CUTOFF_CREATE_YN, COMPANY_ID ORDER BY TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

SELECT S.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , S.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) AND (@companyId IS NULL OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId)

SELECT S.COMPANY_ID AS CODE, D.SEGMENT2 AS NAME, S.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE S INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON S.COMPANY_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'COMPANY_DESC' WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' GROUP BY S.COMPANY_ID, D.SEGMENT2, S.DIVISION_ID

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN B WHERE B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_EXCEPT_LINE' AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1 AND A.PLANT_ID = B.SEGMENT2 AND A.LINE_ID = B.SEGMENT4 AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.SEGMENT3 AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.SEGMENT5 ) AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroupId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroupId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID || ',') > 0) ORDER BY A.LINE_ID
SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1=1 AND VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF7'), '-', '') AS CODE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NAME , TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FROM_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 55, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TO_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FIRST_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 20, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONFIRM_DAY FROM DUAL

SELECT CODE , NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT VERSION_ID AS CODE , VERSION_ID || ' ' || VERSION_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND (DIVISION_ID = 'EE' OR DIVISION_ID = @divisionId ) AND ( @scpUseFlag IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scpUseFlag || ',', ',' || A.SCP_USE_FLAG || ',') > 0 ) ) A ORDER BY CODE DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(A.ACTIVE_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR A.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ( SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) = 'F' THEN 'A' ELSE REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) end FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(@param3, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) )

SELECT DISTINCT SHOP_GROUP_ID AS CODE , OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID AS CODE , PLANT_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @shopGroupId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @shopGroupId || ',', ',' || A.SHOP_GROUP_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' ) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 JOIN scp_mst_tact_time t on t.division_id=@divisionId and t.plant_site_id=b.SCM_SITE_ID and t.item_id=@itemId and t.operation_id=@operationId and t.line_id=A.LINE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) AND A.OPERATION_ID = @operationId AND (@operationGroup IS NULL OR b.OPERATION_GROUP = @operationGroup ) AND b.SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE ,A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME ,t.PLANT_SITE_ID ,t.ITEM_ID ,t.OPERATION_ID ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' ) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 JOIN scp_mst_tact_time t on t.division_id=A.DIVISION_ID and t.plant_site_id=b.SCM_SITE_ID and t.operation_id=A.OPERATION_ID and t.line_id=A.LINE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND B.OSP_YN = 'N'

SELECT TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY) CODE , TO_NUMBER(B.LANE_QTY) NAME , A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.ITEM_ID , B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE , C.LINE_ID , C.ELECTRODE_TYPE , C.OPERATION_ID FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN A , SCM_ITEM_LANE_M_SN B , SCM_LINE_M_SN C WHERE A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID AND A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID AND B.FACTORY_ID = C.FACTORY_ID AND B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE = C.PROD_VERSION_TYPE AND (SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 5) = C.OPERATION_ID OR SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID,6,5) = C.OPERATION_ID OR SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID,11,5) = C.OPERATION_ID OR SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID,16,5) = C.OPERATION_ID OR SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID,12,5) = C.OPERATION_ID) ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID , B.LANE_QTY, B.PROD_VERSION_TYPE , C.LINE_ID, C.ELECTRODE_TYPE

SELECT A.TO_SITE AS CODE , CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.TO_SITE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME FROM ( SELECT distinct SEGMENT3 TO_SITE FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND SEGMENT2 = @segment2 AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.TO_SITE = B.SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY CODE

SELECT TO_SITE AS CODE , TO_SITE AS NAME FROM( SELECT distinct SEGMENT3 TO_SITE FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND SEGMENT2 = @segment2 AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A ORDER BY TO_SITE ASC

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE ,B.SEGMENT2 NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_GROUP' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.SEGMENT1 IN ('P','A') ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE ,B.SEGMENT2 NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_GROUP' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.SEGMENT1 IN ('A','E') ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND INSTR(',' || ( CASE WHEN @divisionId='40' THEN 'P,A' ELSE 'P' END ) || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ORDER BY CODE

SELECT * FROM( SELECT SEGMENT4 as code, d.OPERATION_NAME as name FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b join SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN d on b.SEGMENT4 = d.OPERATION_ID WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' AND (@param1 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || b.segment5 || ',', ',' || @param1 || ',') > 0) GROUP BY SEGMENT4,d.OPERATION_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'VENDOR' code, 'VENDOR' name ) A ORDER BY name

SELECT 'PP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD CODE , 'PP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'SP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD CODE , 'SP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'SP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD CODE , 'SP_W_' || PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT distinct S.PLANT_ID AS CODE ,S.PLANT_ID || ' ' || (CASE WHEN A.PLANT_NAME IS NULL THEN V.VENDOR_NAME ELSE A.PLANT_NAME END ) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A ON A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = S.PLANT_ID WHERE ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || s.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND S.VALID_YN ='Y' AND S.PLANT_ID IS NOT NULL AND S.osp_yn = 'N' ORDER BY S.PLANT_ID

SELECT S.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) AND (@companyId IS NULL OR S.COMPANY_ID=@companyId) AND not exists (select 1 from ( select SEGMENT1 AS company_id FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL where 1=1 AND lookup_type = 'SSP_UI_EXCEPT_COMPANY' AND VALID_YN = 'y' ) K where @companyId = K.company_id)

SELECT REPLACE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, '-', '') CODE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NAME , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) FROM_DATE , (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + (55)) TO_DATE , (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + (14)) TO_DATE1 , PLAN_CUTOFF_CREATE_YN AS PLAN_YN, COMPANY_ID FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE WHERE 1= 1 AND ERP_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'Y' AND OWMS_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'Y' AND CURRENT_PLAN_DATE_YN = 'Y' AND (@companyId IS NULL OR COMPANY_ID=@companyId) GROUP BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, PLAN_CUTOFF_CREATE_YN, COMPANY_ID ORDER BY TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT a.ITEM_ID CODE ,a.ITEM_ID NAME FROM scp_mst_bod_item a INNER JOIN scp_mst_bod b ON a.bod_id = b.bod_id AND B.incoterms='DAP' INNER JOIN scm_mst_site sf on sf.scm_site_id=b.from_site and sf.valid_yn='Y' and sf.operation_group=@operationGroup INNER JOIN scm_mst_site st on st.scm_site_id=b.TO_SITE and st.valid_yn='Y' and st.SITE_TYPE='PLANT' WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY P WHERE P.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID=B.FROM_SITE AND P.ITEM_ID=A.ITEM_ID AND P.VALID_YN='Y') order by item_id

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.COMPANY_ID AS CODE, D.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON S.COMPANY_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'COMPANY_DESC' INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON S.COMPANY_ID = CASE WHEN U.COMPANY_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_SCP', 'COMPANY_SALES') THEN FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_SCP', 'ESOC') ELSE U.COMPANY_ID END WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND (@sesUserId IS NULL OR U.USER_ID=@sesUserId) GROUP BY S.COMPANY_ID, D.SEGMENT2, S.DIVISION_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1

SELECT DIVISION_ID AS CODE, DIVISION_ID || ' ' || MIN(DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION WHERE DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID = @__GROUP__ AND UserID = @sesUserId AND AuthType = ( CASE WHEN @__GROUP__ = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END )) AND DIVISION_ID != '40' AND ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE' GROUP BY DIVISION_ID ORDER BY DIVISION_ID

SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID , PLANT_NAME FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID , CASE WHEN B.DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NVL(B.PLANT_NAME, V.VENDOR_NAME) ELSE B.DESCRIPTION END AS PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = A.PLANT_ID AND V.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND (NVL(@divisionId, '~') NOT IN ('EE','EE_UC') AND OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A','P' )) AND OSP_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID , CASE WHEN V.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL THEN NVL(B.PLANT_NAME, V.VENDOR_NAME) ELSE V.ATTRIBUTE1 END AS PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = A.PLANT_ID AND V.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A','P' ) AND OSP_YN = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' UNION ALL SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID,B.PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND OSP_YN = 'N' AND ((@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId IN ('EE','EE_UC')) AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' ) ) X ORDER BY X.PLANT_ID

SELECT code, name FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 4 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 4 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 3 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 3 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 2 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 2 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 1 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 1 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') name ) A ORDER BY CODE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE, (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || B.OPERATION_NAME) NAME, A.OPERATION_ID, B.SORT_BASIS FROM SCM_line_HIERARCHY_V_SN A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT OPERATION_ID , CASE WHEN OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'E' THEN 1 WHEN OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A' THEN 2 WHEN OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'F' THEN 3 WHEN OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'P' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END SORT_BASIS, OPERATION_NAME FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN B ) B ON A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @lineId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @lineId || ',', ',' || A.LINE_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroupId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroupId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID || ',') > 0) AND SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) IN ( SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY B.SORT_BASIS, A.OPERATION_ID

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE , CASE WHEN SEGMENT1 IN ('LA001', 'LA002','LA003' ) THEN ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE ATTRIBUTE2 END AS NAME , SEGMENT1 AS LOSS_CODE , ATTRIBUTE1 AS CATEGORY_ID , ATTRIBUTE3 AS DATA_TABLE , ATTRIBUTE4 AS OFF_CAL , ATTRIBUTE5 AS FP_UTIL_CAL , ATTRIBUTE6 AS SCP_UTIL_CAL , SORT_ORDER FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN LV WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'CAPA_UI_LOSS_TYPE_DEFINIT' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ATTRIBUTE7 = 'Y' AND (@attribute1 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @attribute1 || ',', ',' || LV.ATTRIBUTE1 || ',') > 0)

SELECT A.plan_start_yyyymmdd AS CODE , TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = B.basis_yyyymmdd WHERE 1=1 AND A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND A.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT PLAN_SEQ AS CODE , TO_CHAR(PLAN_SEQ) AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A WHERE 1=1 AND DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = @planStartYyyymmdd AND PLAN_TYPE = @planType AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY PLAN_SEQ ORDER BY PLAN_SEQ DESC

SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_CPS_V_SN A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.LINE_ID , A.LINE_NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID ORDER BY A.LINE_ID

SELECT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(A.ACTIVE_FLAG,'N') = 'Y' GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID , A.FACTORY_NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID
