SELECT X.DIVISION_ID , X.PLANT_ID , X.PLANT_NAME FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID , CASE WHEN B.DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN NVL(B.PLANT_NAME, V.VENDOR_NAME) ELSE B.DESCRIPTION END AS PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = A.PLANT_ID AND V.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND (A.DIVISION_ID NOT IN ('EE','EE_UC') AND OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A','P' )) AND OSP_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID , CASE WHEN V.ATTRIBUTE1 IS NULL THEN NVL(B.PLANT_NAME, V.VENDOR_NAME) ELSE V.ATTRIBUTE1 END AS PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = A.PLANT_ID AND V.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A','P' ) AND OSP_YN = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' UNION ALL SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID , B.PLANT_NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN SCM_PLANT_M_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.OSP_YN = 'N' AND ((A.DIVISION_ID IN ('EE','EE_UC')) AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'E') ) X GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID , X.PLANT_ID , X.PLANT_NAME ORDER BY X.DIVISION_ID , X.PLANT_ID , X.PLANT_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(VERSION_NO, 6, 4) AS CODE FROM DM_MST_VERSION WHERE 1=1 AND VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W' AND VERSION_DESCRIPTION = 'MKT FCST Weekly Cutoff' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY CODE DESC

SELECT B.WEEK_NAME AS CODE , MAX(A.YYYYMMDD || '-' || B.WEEK_NAME) AS NAME FROM DM_MST_VERSION A JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD WHERE 1=1 AND A.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W' AND VERSION_DESCRIPTION = 'MKT FCST Weekly Cutoff' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR SUBSTR(A.YYYYMMDD, 1, 4) = @param2 ) AND A.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR((FN_NEXT_DAY( SYSDATE, 'SUN') + (-7)), 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY B.WEEK_NAME ORDER BY NAME DESC

SELECT DIVISION_ID , CODE , NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID , LK2.SEGMENT2 AS CODE , LK2.SEGMENT3 AS NAME , LK2.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK1 ON A.PROJECT_CODE = LK1.SEGMENT1 AND LK1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ITEM_USE_EX' LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK2 ON A.DIVISION_ID = LK2.SEGMENT1 AND NVL(LK1.SEGMENT2, SUBSTR(A.PROJECT_CODE, 1, 1)) = LK2.SEGMENT2 AND LK2.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ITEM_USE' WHERE A.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND LK2.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY ) X

SELECT DISTINCT A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE , A.PROJECT_CODE AS NAME , CASE WHEN B.PROJECT_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE B.PROJECT_NAME END AS NAME2 , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCM_SITE_ID , A.ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PROJECT_CODE = B.PROJECT_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) AND (@scmSiteId IS NULL OR A.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId) AND (@itemId IS NULL OR A.ITEM_ID=@itemId)

SELECT 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD CODE , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT Value FROM FN_SplitString(@divisionId,',')) ) C ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.DIVISION_ID= @divisionId AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC

SELECT 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD CODE , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT Value FROM FN_SplitString(@divisionId,',')) ) C ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.DIVISION_ID= @divisionId AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT code, name || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' as name FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 4 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 4 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 3 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 3 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 2 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 2 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 1 * 7, 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') - 1 * 7, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS name union SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'yyyyMMdd') code, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') name ) A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.code = B.basis_yyyymmdd ORDER BY CODE DESC
SELECT DISTINCT SHOP_GROUP_ID AS CODE , OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID = 'E'

SELECT DISTINCT SHOP_GROUP_ID AS CODE , OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID <> 'E'
SELECT L.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , L.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'BUCKET_TYPE_CODE_ISO' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE 1 = 1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OSP_YN = 'Y' AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT DISTINCT D.DEPT_ID AS CODE , CASE WHEN ( NVL(( SELECT MAX(U.LANGUAGE) FROM TB_FX_USER U WHERE U.USERID = @sesUserId ), 'KO') ) = 'EN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN ( NVL(( SELECT MAX(U.LANGUAGE) FROM TB_FX_USER U WHERE U.USERID = @sesUserId ), 'KO') ) = 'CN' THEN D.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE D.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS NAME , D.DEPT_NAME_KO , D.DEPT_NAME_EN , D.DEPT_NAME_CN FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON F.ATTRIBUTE6 = U.USER_ID JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || F.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)

SELECT HORIZON_START_DATE ,HORIZON_END_DATE ,PLAN_CYCLE ,((HORIZON_END_DATE - PLAN_NAME)) AS DIFF_WEEK FROM SCM_MST_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND PLAN_NAME = @planName AND DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'

SELECT DISTINCT A.GROUP_CODE1 AS CODE , A.GROUP_CODE1 AS NAME FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P') AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @itemId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @itemId || ',', ',' || A.ITEM_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @nickName IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @nickName || ',', ',' || A.NICK_NAME || ',') > 0) ORDER BY CODE

SELECT s.division_id ,s.plant_id ,s.scm_site_id ,s.country ,s.company_id FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE s.site_type = 'PLANT' and s.operation_group = 'A' and s.company_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_SCP', 'ESOC') and s.valid_yn = 'Y'
SELECT * FROM FN_GET_SCP_ITEM_INACTIVE(@param1, @param2)
SELECT * FROM FN_GET_DIVISION(@param1, @param2) ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE1

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , B.CODE , B.NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A , ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID , IA.CODE , IA.NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY IA.DIVISION_ID , IA.CODE ORDER BY IA.NAME DESC ) AS RN FROM ( SELECT C.DIVISION_ID , C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , CASE WHEN E.FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || D.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || D.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V C , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M D , SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN E WHERE C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = D.BASIS_YYYYMMDD AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = E.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD (+) AND C.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID (+) GROUP BY C.DIVISION_ID , C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , D.WEEK_NAME , E.FP_TARGET_YN ) IA ) B WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.CODE AND B.RN = 1 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , B.CODE , B.NAME ORDER BY NAME DESC

SELECT DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , MRP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , MRP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , MRP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ORDER BY MRP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC

SELECT DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , ITEM_CATEGORY AS CODE , ITEM_CATEGORY AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , ITEM_CATEGORY ORDER BY ITEM_CATEGORY

SELECT DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , NICKNAME , MATERIAL AS CODE , MATERIAL AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID , SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , NICKNAME , MATERIAL ORDER BY MATERIAL

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.CODE , A.NAME FROM ( SELECT IA.DIVISION_ID , IA.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , IA.COMPANY , IA.SUPPLIER AS CODE , NVL(V1.VENDOR_NAME, V2.VENDOR_NAME) AS NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT XA.DIVISION_ID , XA.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , XA.COMPANY , REGEXP_SUBSTR(XA.SUPPLIER, '[^^]+', 1, L.LV) AS SUPPLIER FROM ( SELECT B.DIVISION_ID , B.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , B.COMPANY , B.SUPPLIER FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY B WHERE B.SUPPLIER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID , B.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , B.COMPANY , B.SUPPLIER ) XA , ( SELECT LEVEL AS LV FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 20 ) L WHERE REGEXP_SUBSTR(XA.SUPPLIER, '[^^]+', 1, L.LV) IS NOT NULL ) IA , ( SELECT C.VENDOR_CODE , C.VENDOR_NAME FROM SCM_MST_VENDOR C WHERE C.COMPANY_ID = 'C100' GROUP BY C.VENDOR_CODE , C.VENDOR_NAME ) V1 , ( SELECT D.COMPANY_ID , D.VENDOR_CODE , D.VENDOR_NAME FROM SCM_MST_VENDOR D ) V2 WHERE IA.SUPPLIER = V1.VENDOR_CODE (+) AND IA.COMPANY = V2.COMPANY_ID (+) AND IA.SUPPLIER = V2.VENDOR_CODE (+) ) A GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.CODE , A.NAME ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.CODE , A.NAME

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.OPERATION_GROUP AS CODE , A.OPERATION_GROUP AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(OPERATION_GROUP, '-') <> '-' GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.OPERATION_GROUP ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.OPERATION_GROUP

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.PLANT_ID AS CODE , (A.PLANT_ID || ' ' || B.PLANT_NAME) AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A JOIN SCM_MST_PLANT_SN B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.PLANT_ID , B.PLANT_NAME ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.PLANT_ID

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , '' AS OPERATION_GROUP , A.NICKNAME AS CODE , A.NICKNAME AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.NICKNAME ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.NICKNAME

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , '' AS OPERATION_GROUP , A.NICKNAME , A.ITEM_ID AS CODE , A.ITEM_ID AS NAME FROM SCP_ANL_MAT_SUPPLY A WHERE 1=1 AND A.ITEM_ID <> 'SUM' AND A.ITEM_ID <> '-' GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.ATTRIBUTE3 , A.NICKNAME , A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.SCP_PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , A.ATTRIBUTE3 , A.NICKNAME , A.ITEM_ID

SELECT A.FROM_SITE AS CODE , CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.FROM_SITE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME ,A.OPERATION_GROUP ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT distinct SEGMENT3 FROM_SITE , SEGMENT2 OPERATION_GROUP , SEGMENT1 DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PSI_PRODUCTION' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND ( @segment2 IS NULL OR SEGMENT2 = @segment2) AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.FROM_SITE = B.SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY CODE

SELECT '-' AS CODE, '-' AS NAME , '-' AS DIVISION_ID UNION ALL SELECT A.PLANT_SITE_ID AS CODE ,CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.PLANT_SITE_ID WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME, A.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT2 PLANT_SITE_ID , SEGMENT4 DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PROBLEM_REPORT_DEMAND' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @segment4 IS NULL OR SEGMENT4 = @segment4 ) ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY CODE

SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT3 CODE ,SEGMENT3 NAME ,SEGMENT4 DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PROBLEM_REPORT_DEMAND' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @segment4 IS NULL OR SEGMENT4 = @segment4) ORDER BY CODE

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.SCM_SITE_ID WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID ,A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT3 SCM_SITE_ID, ATTRIBUTE2 DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PRODUCTION_PLAN' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND ( @segment2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @segment2 || ',', ',' || SEGMENT2 || ',') > 0) AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @attribute2 IS NULL OR ATTRIBUTE2 = @attribute2) AND ((NVL(@param3, '~') <> 'JV Planner') OR INSTR(',' || @segment3 || ',', ',' || SEGMENT3 || ',') > 0) ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY CODE

SELECT DISTINCT A.CODE , A.NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.SITE_ID FROM ( SELECT A.LINE_ID AS CODE , A.LINE_ID || '   ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME , C.DIVISION_ID , C.OPERATION_GROUP , C.SCM_SITE_ID AS SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A , ( SELECT SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP , SEGMENT3 AS SCM_SITE_ID , SEGMENT4 AS LINE_ID , SEGMENT5 AS OPERATION_ID , ATTRIBUTE1 AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID , ATTRIBUTE2 AS DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PRODUCTION_PLAN' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = C.LINE_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID ) A UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS CODE , '-' AS NAME , '-' AS B , '-' AS C , '-' AS D FROM DUAL ORDER BY NAME

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE ,A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME ,C.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID DIVISION_ID , C.OPERATION_GROUP , C.SCM_SITE_ID SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN (SELECT SEGMENT2 OPERATION_GROUP ,SEGMENT3 SCM_SITE_ID ,SEGMENT4 LINE_ID ,SEGMENT5 OPERATION_ID ,ATTRIBUTE1 ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_PRODUCTION_PLAN' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SSP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ATTRIBUTE2 = @attribute2 ) C ON C.OPERATION_GROUP = @operationGroup AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || C.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0 ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID AND A.LINE_ID = C.LINE_ID AND A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS CODE ,'-' AS NAME ,'-' AS B , '-' AS C ,'-' AS ED ORDER BY NAME

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY ,A.DIVISION_ID DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) UNION SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCM_SITE_ID LIKE '%' || '-A' ORDER BY SITE_TYPE

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.DIVISION_ID || ' ' || A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION || (CASE WHEN B.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ' Y' ELSE ' N' END) NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP , B.ITEM_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.PLANT_SITE_ID , T.ITEM_ID FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON S.SCM_SITE_ID = T.PLANT_SITE_ID JOIN SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS ON LS.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = T.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID AND LS.OPERATION_ID = T.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID = T.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND T.VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY T.ITEM_ID , T.PLANT_SITE_ID UNION ALL SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID , ITEM_ID FROM SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA WHERE 1=1 AND VALID_YN ='Y' GROUP BY PLANT_SITE_ID , ITEM_ID ) B ON A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' ) A GROUP BY DIVISION_ID , CODE , NAME , OPERATION_GROUP , ITEM_ID ORDER BY DIVISION_ID , CODE

SELECT A.TO_SITE AS CODE , CASE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN A.TO_SITE WHEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN B.SITE_DESCRIPTION END AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT3 AS TO_SITE , SEGMENT4 AS DIVISION_ID , SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_SHIPMENT_PLAN_SEMI' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.TO_SITE = B.SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY A.TO_SITE , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP

SELECT SEGMENT3 As CODE , SEGMENT3 As NAME , SEGMENT4 AS DIVISION_ID , SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE 1=1 AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'EE_SHIPMENT_PLAN_FG' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SCP' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY SEGMENT3 , SEGMENT4 , SEGMENT2 ORDER BY SEGMENT3

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' ORDER BY CODE

SELECT '-' AS CODE, '-' AS NAME, '-' AS DIVISION_ID UNION ALL SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = 'D')

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME , CITY , OSP_YN , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = ( CASE WHEN @divisionId = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END ))

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,SITE_TYPE ,CITY ,A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = 'D') AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.OSP_YN = 'N' ANd A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.OSP_YN , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME ,A.OSP_YN ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'N' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 )
SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID ,A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.OSP_YN , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.OSP_YN , A.OPERATION_GROUP , A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ANd A.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR NVL(A.ATTRIBUTE1,'N') = @param3 )

SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, '-', '') CODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NAME, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) FROM_DATE, (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + (84)) AS TO_DATE FROM ( SELECT ATTRIBUTE1 AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL X WHERE X.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_ANL_ESS_PLAN' AND X.SEGMENT1 = '82' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SSP_ANL_ESS_PLAN ) T0 ORDER BY REPLACE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, '-', '') DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SCP_EXTRA_SPEC AS CODE, SCP_EXTRA_SPEC AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A INNER JOIN ( SELECT SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0) )B ON A.SITE_ID IN (B.SITE_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND A.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC IS NOT NULL AND A.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC <> '' AND INSTR(',' || @flowId || ',', ',' || A.FLOW_ID || ',') > 0 AND ( @divisionId ='40' ) UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS CODE,'-' AS NAME FROM DUAL WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId, '~') <>'40' ) ) ORDER BY NAME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS_NAME AS CODE, ITEM_CLASS_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A INNER JOIN ( SELECT SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE WHERE ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || PLANT_ID || ',') > 0) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0) )B ON A.SITE_ID IN (B.SITE_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND A.ITEM_CLASS IS NOT NULL AND A.ITEM_CLASS <> '' AND A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME <> '' AND INSTR(',' || @flowId || ',', ',' || A.FLOW_ID || ',') > 0 AND INSTR(',' || @scpExtraSpec || ',', ',' || A.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC || ',') > 0 AND ( @divisionId ='40' ) UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS CODE,'-' AS NAME FROM DUAL WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId, '~') <>'40' ) ) ORDER BY NAME

SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT4 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND SEGMENT3 = 'Y' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SEGMENT4 <> 'E2000' ORDER BY SEGMENT4

SELECT DISTINCT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'R5500' THEN (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || 'ESS Eack') ELSE (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || C.OPERATION_NAME) END AS NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT OPERATION_GROUP , SUBSTR(FLOW_ID, 1, 5) AS OPERATION_ID FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM ) A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN C ON A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E' AND A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('P5200') ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'PP_W_' || A.plan_start_yyyymmdd AS CODE , 'PP_W_' || A.plan_start_yyyymmdd || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = B.basis_yyyymmdd WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '-FN-' || TO_CHAR(IA.MAX_SEQ) AS CODE , IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '-FN-' || TO_CHAR(IA.MAX_SEQ) AS NAME , ( SELECT DISTINCT 1 FROM SCP_ANL_DIO_REPORT B WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = IA.DIVISION_ID AND B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = IA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND B.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND B.SEQ = IA.MAX_SEQ ) AS CODEDESC , ( SELECT XA.EDIT_CYCLE_VERSION FROM ( SELECT C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '-FN-' || TO_CHAR(C.SEQ) AS EDIT_CYCLE_VERSION FROM SCP_ANL_DIO_REPORT C WHERE C.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId GROUP BY C.DIVISION_ID , C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , C.PLAN_TYPE , C.SEQ ) XA WHERE ROWNUM <= 1 ) AS EDIT_CYCLE_VERSION FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , MAX(A.PLAN_SEQ) AS MAX_SEQ FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND A.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ) IA ORDER BY CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT DISTINCT CODE , NAME FROM ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , DATE_FULL_NAME || ' (' || WEEK_NAME || ')' AS NAME FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW'), 'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , B.DATE_FULL_NAME || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' AS NAME FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD WHERE ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) ) A ORDER BY CODE DESC

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || A.OPERATION_NAME AS NAME , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_ID , A.OPERATION_NAME , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , MAX(A.DISPLAY_SEQ) AS DISPLAY_SEQ FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_ID , O.OPERATION_NAME , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD , A.ELTR_LN_TP_NM , A.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM ( SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID , B.SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_ID , B.SEGMENT3 AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD , B.SEGMENT3 AS ELTR_LN_TP_NM , B.SEGMENT4 AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID , B.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP' AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT A.OPERATION_ID , A.OPERATION_NAME FROM ( SELECT A.OPERATION_ID , MAX(A.OPERATION_NAME) AS OPERATION_NAME FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN A GROUP BY A.OPERATION_ID UNION ALL SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID , B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS OPERATION_NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP' AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CPS_FORMATION_OPERATION' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY B.SEGMENT1 , B.ATTRIBUTE1 ) A ) O ON A.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID ) A GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_ID , A.OPERATION_NAME , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID ) A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ('E')

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.COMPANY_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID , A.LINE_ID , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID) DIVISION_NAME , (A.SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_NAME) SITE_NAME , (A.COMPANY_ID || ' ' || A.COMPANY_NAME) COMPANY_NAME , (A.PLANT_ID || ' ' || A.PLANT_NAME) PLANT_NAME , (A.FACTORY_ID || ' ' || A.FACTORY_NAME) FACTORY_NAME , (A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME) LINE_NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'A' THEN 'Assembly' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'B' THEN 'Pack' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'E' THEN 'Electrode' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'F' THEN 'Formation' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'Pack' ELSE '-' END AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME , A.SITE_NAME AS SITE_NAME_ , A.COMPANY_NAME AS COMPANY_NAME_ , A.PLANT_NAME AS PLANT_NAME_ , A.FACTORY_NAME AS FACTORY_NAME_ , A.LINE_NAME AS LINE_NAME_ , CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'A' THEN 'Assembly' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'B' THEN 'Pack' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'E' THEN 'Electrode' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'F' THEN 'Formation' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'Pack' ELSE '-' END AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME_ FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE A WHERE 1=1

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.COMPANY_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID , A.LINE_ID , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID) DIVISION_NAME , (A.SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_NAME) SITE_NAME , (A.COMPANY_ID || ' ' || A.COMPANY_NAME) COMPANY_NAME , (A.PLANT_ID || ' ' || A.PLANT_NAME) PLANT_NAME , (A.FACTORY_ID || ' ' || A.FACTORY_NAME) FACTORY_NAME , (A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME) LINE_NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'A' THEN 'Assembly' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'B' THEN 'Pack' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'E' THEN 'Electrode' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'F' THEN 'Formation' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'Pack' ELSE '-' END AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME , A.SITE_NAME AS SITE_NAME_ , A.COMPANY_NAME AS COMPANY_NAME_ , A.PLANT_NAME AS PLANT_NAME_ , A.FACTORY_NAME AS FACTORY_NAME_ , A.LINE_NAME AS LINE_NAME_ , CASE WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'A' THEN 'Assembly' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'B' THEN 'Pack' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'E' THEN 'Electrode' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'F' THEN 'Formation' WHEN A.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'P' THEN 'Pack' ELSE '-' END AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME_ FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE A WHERE 1=1
select OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID AS CODE , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_NAME AS NAME , DIVISION_ID from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_GR_M where VALID_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE4 AS LINK_UI_TYPE , A.ATTRIBUTE5 AS PROGRAM_NAME , A.ATTRIBUTE6 AS CONFIRM_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE7 AS AUTO_YN , A.ATTRIBUTE8 AS OPTION_YN FROM ( SELECT * FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPMZ_ACTV_CD' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A ORDER BY CODE

select OPMZ_PLAN_ID AS CODE , OPMZ_PLAN_ID AS NAME , OPMZ_PLAN_GR_ID , OPMZ_PRS_CD , DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD from SCP_OPMZ_PLAN_M where 1=1 and NVL(ATTRIBUTE10, '') != 'AI' and PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD between TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6), 'YYYYMMDD') and TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT A.PLAN_NAME AS CODE , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_NAME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_NAME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END name , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_PLAN A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_NAME = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 ) C ON A.PLAN_NAME = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.plan_cycle = 'WEEKLY' AND A.plan_name >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-24) ORDER BY A.PLAN_NAME DESC

SELECT LMS.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , LMS.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME , LMS.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE MS INNER JOIN SCM_MST_PLANT_SN MP ON MS.PLANT_ID = MP.PLANT_ID AND MS.COMPANY_ID = MP.COMPANY_ID AND MS.DIVISION_ID = MP.DIVISION_ID AND MP.PLANT_TYPE = 'VIRTUAL' INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE LMS ON MP.LINK_PLANT_ID = LMS.PLANT_ID AND MS.OPERATION_GROUP = LMS.OPERATION_GROUP WHERE MS.SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId AND MS.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId

SELECT '-' AS CODE, '-' AS NAME, NULL AS DIVISION_ID, NULL AS SCM_SITE_ID FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT LINE_ID AS CODE, LINE_NAME AS NAME, DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP WHERE NVL(VALID_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND DIVISION_ID IN ( SELECT U.UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND U.USER_GR_ID IN ( SELECT G.USER_GR_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY 2

SELECT distinct S.PLANT_ID AS CODE , MAX((CASE WHEN A.PLANT_NAME IS NULL THEN V.VENDOR_NAME ELSE A.PLANT_NAME END )) AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE S LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A ON A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = S.PLANT_ID WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR S.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND ( (@plantId IS NULL OR S.PLANT_ID LIKE '%' || @plantId || '%') OR (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_NAME LIKE '%' || @plantId || '%') ) AND S.VALID_YN ='Y' GROUP BY S.PLANT_ID ORDER BY S.PLANT_ID

SELECT SOLDTO_CODE AS CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER WHERE (@divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND ( (@soldtoCode IS NULL OR SOLDTO_CODE LIKE '%' || @soldtoCode || '%') OR (@soldtoCode IS NULL OR SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || @soldtoCode || '%') ) group by SOLDTO_CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION

SELECT SOLDTO_CODE AS CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER WHERE DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND SOLDTO_CODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE PrntCode = @divisionId AND GroupID = @__GROUP__ AND UserID = @sesUserId AND AuthType = 'C') ORDER BY SOLDTO_CODE
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PERIOD_TYPE' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT GroupID AS CODE, GrpName AS NAME FROM TB_FX_GROUPINFO ORDER BY GroupID

SELECT G.GroupID AS CODE, G.GrpName AS NAME FROM TB_FX_GroupInfo G , TB_FX_UserGroupinfo U WHERE G.UseYN = 'Y' AND U.UseYN = 'Y' AND G.GroupID = U.GroupID AND U.UserID = U.UserID AND U.UserID = @sesUserId AND G.GroupID != 'Guest' ORDER BY G.GroupID

SELECT G.GroupID AS CODE, G.GrpName AS NAME FROM TB_FX_GroupInfo G , TB_FX_UserGroupInfo U WHERE U.UseYN = 'Y' AND G.GroupID = U.GroupID AND U.UserID = U.UserID AND U.UserID = @sesUserId ORDER BY G.GroupID

SELECT DEPT_ID AS CODE , CASE @param1 WHEN 'KO' THEN DEPT_NAME_KO WHEN 'EN' THEN DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN DEPT_NAME_CN END AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO WHERE (@deptId IS NULL OR DEPT_ID LIKE '%' || @deptId || '%') OR (@deptId IS NULL OR DEPT_NAME_KO LIKE '%' || @deptId || '%') OR (@deptId IS NULL OR DEPT_NAME_EN LIKE '%' || @deptId || '%') OR (@deptId IS NULL OR DEPT_NAME_CN LIKE '%' || @deptId || '%') ORDER BY CODE

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = 'D')

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 AND A.OSP_YN ='Y'
SELECT A.PLANT_ID AS CODE , A.PLANT_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0
SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT DISTINCT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || B.OPERATION_NAME) NAME, A.OPERATION_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN B ON A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @pPlantSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@pPlantSiteId,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY A.OPERATION_ID

SELECT SEGMENT4 as code, d.OPERATION_NAME as name FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b join SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN d on b.SEGMENT4 = d.OPERATION_ID WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' AND (@orADivisionIdIn IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || b.segment5 || ',', ',' || @orADivisionIdIn || ',') > 0) GROUP BY SEGMENT4,d.OPERATION_NAME ORDER BY OPERATION_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND ( @endCustomer IS NULL OR @endCustomer = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || A.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = 'D') AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SCM_SITE_ID ASC

SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SCM_SITE_ID || '   ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION || ' ' || CASE WHEN B.PLANT_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP , B.ITEM_ID FROM ( SELECT C.SCM_SITE_ID , C.SITE_DESCRIPTION , C.PLANT_ID , C.OSP_YN , C.COMPANY_ID , C.SITE_ID , C.DIVISION_ID , C.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE C WHERE C.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND C.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || C.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || C.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) AND C.OSP_YN = 'N' AND C.PLANT_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT D.PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN_V D WHERE INSTR(',' || @param3 || ',', ',' || D.MODEL_ID || ',') > 0 ) UNION SELECT E.SCM_SITE_ID , E.SITE_DESCRIPTION , E.PLANT_ID , E.OSP_YN , E.COMPANY_ID , E.SITE_ID , E.DIVISION_ID , E.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE E WHERE E.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND E.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || E.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || E.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) AND E.OSP_YN = 'Y' ) A , ( SELECT DISTINCT IA.PLANT_SITE_ID , IA.ITEM_ID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT T.PLANT_SITE_ID , T.ITEM_ID , T.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE S , SCM_MST_LINE_SN LS , SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T WHERE S.SCM_SITE_ID = T.PLANT_SITE_ID AND LS.COMPANY_ID = S.COMPANY_ID AND LS.DIVISION_ID = T.DIVISION_ID AND LS.SITE_ID = S.SITE_ID AND LS.PLANT_ID = S.PLANT_ID AND LS.OPERATION_ID = T.OPERATION_ID AND LS.LINE_ID = T.LINE_ID AND LS.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND T.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || T.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @param3 || ',', ',' || T.ITEM_ID || ',') > 0 ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT U.PLANT_SITE_ID , U.ITEM_ID , U.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE V , SCM_MST_LINE_OSP W , SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP U WHERE V.SCM_SITE_ID = U.PLANT_SITE_ID AND W.DIVISION_ID = U.DIVISION_ID AND W.SCM_SITE_ID = U.PLANT_SITE_ID AND W.LINE_ID = U.LINE_ID AND W.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND U.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || U.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param3 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @param3 || ',', ',' || U.ITEM_ID || ',') > 0 ) ) IA ) B WHERE A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.PLANT_SITE_ID (+) ORDER BY CODE

SELECT CODE , NAME , DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE 'PP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END AS NAME , C.DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN ) C ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' ) A GROUP BY CODE , NAME , DIVISION_ID ORDER BY A.NAME DESC

SELECT A.CODE , A.NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE 'SP_W_' || A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN ) C ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PLAN_TYPE ='FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG ='Y' ) A GROUP BY A.CODE , A.NAME , A.DIVISION_ID ORDER BY A.CODE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME , S.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE 1 = 1 AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND OSP_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT DISTINCT STORAGE_ID AS CODE , (STORAGE_ID || ' ' || STORAGE_DESCRIPTION) NAME , DIVISION_ID , PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SLOC WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId))

SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )
SELECT DISTINCT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE , A.FACTORY_NAME AS NAME ,PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT SOLDTO_CODE AS CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION AS NAME, A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_CUSTOMER A WHERE ( @divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND ( ( @soldtoCode IS NULL OR SOLDTO_CODE LIKE '%' || @soldtoCode || '%') OR ( @soldtoCode IS NULL OR SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || @soldtoCode || '%') ) group by SOLDTO_CODE, SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION, A.DIVISION_ID ORDER BY SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION

SELECT A.plan_start_yyyymmdd AS code , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END name , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = B.basis_yyyymmdd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT Value FROM FN_SplitString(@divisionId,','))) ) C ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.division_id= @divisionId ) AND ( @versionId IS NULL OR A.version_id = @versionId ) GROUP BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd, B.WEEK_NAME, C.FP_TARGET_YN, A.DIVISION_ID ORDER BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd DESC

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = ( CASE WHEN @__GROUP__ = 'JV Planner' THEN 'J' ELSE 'D' END ))

SELECT A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS CODE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ,DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_RPT_ELEC_PSI A WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.division_id= @divisionId) ) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT BASIS_YYYYMMDD , WEEK_NAME FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M ) B ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD GROUP BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, B.WEEK_NAME , A.DIVISION_ID ORDER BY A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE ,A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID ,B.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' ) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || B.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0 ) UNION SELECT '-' AS CODE ,'-' AS NAME ,'-' AS DIVISION_ID ,'-' AS SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY NAME

SELECT DISTINCT A.LINE_ID AS CODE ,A.LINE_ID || ' ' || A.LINE_NAME AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID ,A.FACTORY_ID ,A.OPERATION_ID ,B.SCM_SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WHERE b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE' AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' AND b.segment3 = 'Y' ) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationId || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @scmSiteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @scmSiteId || ',', ',' || B.SCM_SITE_ID || ',') > 0 ) UNION SELECT '-' AS CODE ,'-' AS NAME ,'-' AS DIVISION_ID ,'-' AS FACTORY_ID ,'-' AS OPERATION_ID ,'-' AS SCM_SITE_ID ORDER BY NAME

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE, B.SEGMENT2 NAME, A.LOOKUP_TYPE LOOKUP_TYPE FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'LOCATION_GROUP' AND (@segment1 IS NULL OR B.SEGMENT3 = @segment1) ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE ,B.SEGMENT2 NAME ,A.LOOKUP_TYPE FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' WHERE( @lookupType IS NULL OR A.LOOKUP_TYPE = @lookupType) AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || B.OPERATION_NAME) NAME, A.OPERATION_ID , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID AS SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN A JOIN SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN B ON A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @param2 IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || SUBSTR(@param2,1,4) || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @factoryId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @factoryId || ',', ',' || A.FACTORY_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @siteId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @siteId || ',', ',' || A.SITE_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY A.OPERATION_ID

SELECT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || B.OPERATION_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID AS FACTORY_ID , A.LINE_ID AS LINE_ID FROM SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_CPS_V_SN A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT OPERATION_ID , OPERATION_NAME FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN B ) B ON A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID GROUP BY A.OPERATION_ID , B.OPERATION_NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.OPERATION_GROUP_ID , A.PLANT_ID , A.FACTORY_ID , A.LINE_ID ORDER BY A.OPERATION_ID

SELECT plan_seq as CODE , ( TO_CHAR(plan_seq)|| ' - ' || (case when confirm_flag is null or confirm_flag ='' then 'N' when confirm_flag = 'Y' then 'Confirm' end) ) NAME , division_id DIVISION_ID , plan_start_yyyymmdd PLANDATE , plan_type PLANTYPE FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE 1=1 and ( @divisionId IS NULL OR division_id = @divisionId) and ( @planStartYyyymmdd IS NULL OR plan_start_yyyymmdd = @planStartYyyymmdd ) and ( @planType IS NULL OR plan_type = @planType ) AND ( @versionId IS NULL OR version_id = @versionId ) GROUP BY plan_seq,confirm_flag, division_id, plan_start_yyyymmdd, plan_type ORDER BY plan_seq DESC

SELECT PLAN_TYPE AS CODE , PLAN_TYPE AS NAME , MAX(PLAN_TYPE_ORDER) PLAN_TYPE_ORDER , DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AS PLANDATE FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY PLAN_TYPE , DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER , DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD

SELECT B.WEEK_NAME AS CODE ,plan_start_yyyymmdd || '-' || B.WEEK_NAME AS name ,division_id DIVISION_ID ,plan_start_yyyymmdd PLAN_YEAR FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V a JOIN scm_sys_calendar_m b ON a.plan_start_yyyymmdd = b.basis_yyyymmdd WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY plan_start_yyyymmdd , b.WEEK_NAME ,division_id ORDER BY name DESC
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(plan_version_id,1,4 ) code ,SUBSTR(plan_version_id,1,4 ) name ,division_id DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V ORDER BY code DESC

SELECT A.PLANT_ID AS CODE , A.PLANT_NAME AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,A.SCM_SITE_ID || ' ' || A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID ,A.OPERATION_GROUP FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.VALID_YN ='Y' AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @operationGroup IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @operationGroup || ',', ',' || A.OPERATION_GROUP || ',') > 0 ) AND ( ( NVL(@param3, '~') <> 'JV Planner' ) OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY CODE

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.OSP_YN ='Y'

SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE , A.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )

SELECT distinct STORAGE_ID CODE ,(STORAGE_ID || ' ' || STORAGE_DESCRIPTION) NAME ,DIVISION_ID ,PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SLOC WHERE 1=1 AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR DIVISION_ID = @divisionId) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId)

SELECT SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE ,SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME ,A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WHERE A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT CODE FROM TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention A WHERE GroupID LIKE '%' || @__GROUP__ || '%' AND UserID LIKE '%' || @sesUserId || '%' AND AuthType = 'D')

SELECT DISTINCT A.OPERATION_ID AS CODE , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID = 'R5500' THEN (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || 'ESS Eack') ELSE (A.OPERATION_ID || ' ' || C.OPERATION_NAME) END AS NAME , C.DIVISION_ID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT OPERATION_GROUP , SUBSTR(FLOW_ID, 1, 5) AS OPERATION_ID FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM ) A LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN C ON A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'E' AND A.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('P5200') ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT B.LEVEL_2_NAME AS CODE ,B.LEVEL_2_NAME AS NAME ,B.LEVEL_1_NAME AS CLASS1 FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_SN B ON A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID WHERE ( @level1Name IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @level1Name || ',', ',' || B.LEVEL_1_NAME || ',') > 0 ) ORDER BY B.LEVEL_2_NAME
SELECT A.CALENDAR_YYYY AS CODE , A.CALENDAR_YYYY AS NAME FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CALENDAR_YYYY >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy') GROUP BY A.CALENDAR_YYYY ORDER BY A.CALENDAR_YYYY

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID , B.SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_ID , B.SEGMENT3 AS CODE , B.SEGMENT3 AS NAME , B.SEGMENT4 AS SHOP_GROUP_ID , B.DISPLAY_SEQ FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP' AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.SEGMENT4 IN ('A', 'P', 'E')

SELECT A.COMPANY_ID AS CODE , MAX(B.COMPANY_NAME) NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_ID , MAX(COMPANY_NAME) AS COMPANY_NAME FROM SCM_MST_COMPANY_SN GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ) B ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID ORDER BY A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID

SELECT A.CODE , A.CODE || ' ' || MAX(A.NAME) NAME , A.DIVISION_ID , A.GR FROM ( SELECT SITE_ID AS CODE , SITE_NAME AS NAME , DIVISION_ID , CASE WHEN DUMMY_YN = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS GR FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL_V WHERE 1=1 AND SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ('A', 'P', 'E') ) A GROUP BY A.CODE , A.DIVISION_ID , A.GR ORDER BY A.GR , A.CODE

SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP' AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CAPA_PROG_STAT' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID , A.VER_ID AS CODE , A.VER_ID AS NAME , A.VER_SEQ , A.PROG_STAT , A.BIZ_PLAN_USE_YN , B.NAME AS PROG_STAT_NAME FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A JOIN ( SELECT B.SEGMENT1 AS CODE , B.SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'SCP' AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CAPA_PROG_STAT' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) B ON A.PROG_STAT = B.CODE ORDER BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.VER_ID DESC , A.VER_SEQ DESC , A.PROG_STAT DESC

SELECT A.CODE , A.CODE || ' ' || MAX(A.NAME) NAME , A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.GR FROM ( SELECT A.PLANT_ID AS CODE , A.PLANT_NAME AS NAME , A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , CASE WHEN A.DUMMY_YN = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS GR FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL_V A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SHOP_GROUP_ID IN ('A', 'P', 'E') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.CODE , A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID , A.GR ORDER BY A.GR , A.CODE , MAX(A.NAME) , A.COMPANY_ID , A.DIVISION_ID , A.SITE_ID , A.SHOP_GROUP_ID

SELECT A.plan_start_yyyymmdd AS code , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END name FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = B.basis_yyyymmdd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT Value FROM FN_SplitString(@divisionId,',')) ) C ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.division_id= @divisionId ) AND ( @versionId IS NULL OR A.version_id = @versionId ) GROUP BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd, B.WEEK_NAME, C.FP_TARGET_YN ORDER BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd DESC

SELECT A.plan_start_yyyymmdd AS code , CASE WHEN FP_TARGET_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.plan_start_yyyymmdd), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || B.WEEK_NAME || ')' || ' (No Plan)' END name , A.DIVISION_ID FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V A INNER JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M B ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = B.basis_yyyymmdd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD , FP_TARGET_YN , MRP_TARGET_YN , DM_RTF_YN FROM SCP_PLN_INTERFACE_YN WHERE 1=1 AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT Value FROM FN_SplitString(@divisionId,',')) ) C ON A.plan_start_yyyymmdd = C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR A.division_id= @divisionId ) AND ( @versionId IS NULL OR A.version_id = @versionId ) GROUP BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd, B.WEEK_NAME, C.FP_TARGET_YN ,A.DIVISION_ID ORDER BY A.plan_start_yyyymmdd DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(@param1, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM'), -1), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM_VALUE, TO_CHAR((TRUNC(TO_DATE(@param1, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM') + (-3)), 'YYYYMMDD') TO_VALUE
SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(@param1, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM'), +1), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM_VALUE, TO_CHAR((ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(@param1, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM'), +2) + (-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') TO_VALUE

SELECT X.CODE
     , X.NAME
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
       , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') <> '40'
    AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
    AND ( @endCustomer IS NULL
      OR @endCustomer = 'ALL'
      OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || A.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0 )
    AND ( @divisionId IS NULL
      OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
      OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
    AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
      SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) )
    AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
      OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
       , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
    AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
  WHERE 1 = 1
    AND NVL(@divisionId, '~') = '40'
    AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
    AND B.PROJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND ( @endCustomer IS NULL
      OR @endCustomer = 'ALL'
      OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || B.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0 )
    AND ( @divisionId IS NULL
      OR @divisionId = 'ALL'
      OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 )
    AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
    SELECT U.UNIT_ID
    FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
    WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
      AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
      AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
      AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
      SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
      WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) )
    AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
      OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' ) ) X
ORDER BY UPPER(X.CODE)

SELECT CODE
     , NAME
FROM (
  SELECT X.CODE
       , X.NAME
       , MIN(X.SORT_ORDER) AS SORT_ORDER
  FROM (
    SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
         , A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME
         , 2 AS SORT_ORDER
    FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
    WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
      AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
        OR A.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
      AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, '~') <> 'W'
      AND ( NVL(@divisionId, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || NVL(A.DIVISION_ID, '~N~') || ',') > 0 )
      AND ( NVL(@endCustomer, 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || NVL(A.END_CUSTOMER, '~N~') || ',') > 0 )
      AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (
      SELECT U.UNIT_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M U
      WHERE U.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
        AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
        AND U.USER_ID = @sesUserId
        AND U.USER_GR_ID IN (
        SELECT G.USER_GR_ID
        FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
        WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId
          AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ) )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT B.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE
         , B.SITE_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
         , 1 AS SORT_ORDER
    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         , SCM_MST_SITE B
    WHERE D.SEGMENT3 = B.DIVISION_ID
      AND D.SEGMENT1 = B.SCM_SITE_ID
      AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT'
      AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
      AND ( NVL(@validYn, 'N') <> 'Y'
        OR B.VALID_YN = 'Y' )
      AND D.SEGMENT3 = @divisionId
      AND @asYn = 'Y' ) X
  GROUP BY X.CODE
       , X.NAME )
ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
     , UPPER(CODE)

SELECT A.PLAN_ID AS CODE, PLAN_ID AS NAME ,A.PLAN_ID ,A.PLAN_TYPE ,A.PLAN_START_TIME ,A.PLAN_HORIZON ,A.PLAN_HORIZON_UOM ,A.DEMAND_HORIZON ,A.DEMAND_HORIZON_UOM ,A.CONFIG_SET_ID ,A.BASIS_PLAN_ID ,A.DEMAND_PLAN_ID ,A.SCP_PLAN_ID ,A.PLAN_WEEK ,TO_CHAR(A.PLAN_START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') PLAN_START_DATE ,TO_CHAR((A.PLAN_START_TIME + (A.PLAN_HORIZON-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') PLAN_END_DATE ,A.INSTANCE_ID FROM SCM_FP_PLAN_H_SN A , ( SELECT C.INSTANCE_ID FROM TH_UIS_USER_FACTORY_RELATE_SN A , TH_UIS_ROLE_FACTORY_RELATE_SN B , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M_SN C WHERE A.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID AND B.FACTORY_ID = C.FACTORY_ID AND A.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY C.INSTANCE_ID ) B WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID AND A.INSTANCE_ID = @instanceId AND A.PLAN_TYPE = @planType AND TO_CHAR(PLAN_START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') = @param2 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(A.PLAN_START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') DESC, A.PLAN_ID DESC

SELECT A.FACTORY_ID AS CODE, '(' || A.FACTORY_ID || ')' || NVL(A.FACTORY_NAME, A.FACTORY_ID) AS NAME FROM SCM_FACTORY_M_SN A , ( SELECT B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID FROM TH_UIS_USER_FACTORY_RELATE_SN A , TH_UIS_ROLE_FACTORY_RELATE_SN B WHERE A.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID AND A.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY B.COMPANY_ID, B.DIVISION_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.FACTORY_ID ) AA WHERE A.COMPANY_ID=AA.COMPANY_ID AND A.DIVISION_ID=AA.DIVISION_ID AND A.SITE_ID=AA.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID=AA.PLANT_ID AND A.FACTORY_ID=AA.FACTORY_ID AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_ID,A.DIVISION_ID,A.SITE_ID,A.PLANT_ID,A.FACTORY_ID FROM SCM_FACTORY_M_SN A INNER JOIN FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M_SN B ON A.FACTORY_ID=B.FACTORY_ID AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.INSTANCE_ID = @instanceId ) C WHERE C.COMPANY_ID=A.COMPANY_ID AND C.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID AND C.SITE_ID=A.SITE_ID AND C.PLANT_ID=A.PLANT_ID AND C.FACTORY_ID=A.FACTORY_ID ) AND ( @divisionId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0 ) AND ( @plantId IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || @plantId || ',', ',' || A.PLANT_ID || ',') > 0 ) GROUP BY A.FACTORY_ID, A.FACTORY_NAME ORDER BY A.FACTORY_ID
